title: Grant Agreement/Application - The Center Equitable Community Revitalization Grant (ECRG) - CA Department of Toxic Substances Control - Facilities Planning and Management Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Grant Agreement (and Grant Application) by and between the District and the State of California, Department of Toxic Substances Control accepting (ECRG-2023-01620 AWARD LETTER: Oakland Unified School District - The Center - 2850 West Street, Oakland, Alameda County, California - CES 4.0 SCORE 82) a  maximum of $1,182,300.00 in Equitable Community Revitalization Grant reimbursement funding for revitalization of the Center site pursuant to applicable guidelines, for  the term from October  1, 2024, through September 30, 2026.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Accepts up to $1,182,300 from the state to clean up and revitalize The Center site
summary: The district would accept a state grant from the California Department of Toxic Substances Control of up to $1,182,300. The money reimburses costs of revitalizing The Center site at 2850 West Street in Oakland. The grant runs from October 1, 2024 through September 30, 2026.
vendor_name: California Department of Toxic Substances Control
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Subgrant Agreement - The Children's Partnership - #SG2024025 - Department of Health Care Services - Oakland Technical High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Subgrant Agreement #SG2024025, by and between the District, on behalf of Oakland Technical High School, and The Children’s Partnership, Los Angeles, CA, in collaboration with the CA Department of Health Care Services, accepting a grant in the amount of $945,805.00, for the implementation of a Peer-to-Peer Youth Mental Health High School Pilot Demonstration Project, as described in Annex 1 (Scope of Work) of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, for the term of August 9, 2024 through June 30, 2027, pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof, if any.
funding_source: The Children’s Partnership Grant via the Department of Health Care Services
headline: Accepts a $945,805 grant for a student peer-to-peer mental health pilot at Oakland Tech
summary: Oakland Technical High School would accept a $945,805 grant through The Children’s Partnership, working with the California Department of Health Care Services. The money pays for a pilot project in which students support each other's mental health. The agreement runs from August 9, 2024 through June 30, 2027.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
